question: What Synology attachment retrieval and staging policy should the plugin support before implementing inbound image, CSV, and PDF handling?
rationale: The code gap is clear, but accepting attachments changes the bundled channel's network and file-ingestion boundary, so automation should not choose the external contract or safe-download policy alone.

options.title: Confirm contract and safe staging
options.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement plugin-local bounded retrieval with MIME/size/lifetime/cleanup tests before enabling the feature.

options.title: Wait for reporter proof
options.body: Keep the issue open until a user supplies redacted NAS webhook payloads and retrieval details, avoiding speculative API support.

options.title: Decline bundled support
options.body: Leave Synology Chat inbound attachments unsupported in the bundled plugin unless maintainers decide this channel warrants the security review cost.

recommendation.title: Confirm contract and safe staging
recommendation.body: Require a real Synology attachment payload/API contract, then implement plugin-local bounded retrieval with MIME/size/lifetime/cleanup tests before enabling the feature.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent Synology Chat review comments and handler/docs refactors make this the best available routing candidate for the security-boundary decision.
